locations.role: final nonexclusive write_text truncates any intervening file

findings.trigger: After the helper creates its new companion artifact directory, another process creates the requested receipt path before the final write.
findings.observed: Unmodified helper returned exit 0 and overwrote the independent sentinel with its successful replay receipt.
findings.impact: Violates the explicit only-new-output contract and can erase another receipt or file created during replay; no scientific/source defect demonstrated.
findings.fix: Use atomic exclusive creation of the receipt at the actual write (e.g. output.open("x")) and fail without altering a file created after preflight. Keep the existing companion-directory exclusive mkdir guard.
findings.regression: Run the real CLI, wait for its companion directory to appear, exclusively create a sentinel receipt, then require nonzero exit and identical sentinel bytes; retain a fresh-output success control.
findings.scope: External proposal only; no maintained installation occurred.

actual_original_source_replay.scope: Executed standalone from a relocated helper/input directory; scientific checks passed, but output collision violated file preservation.

companion_output_scope: Existing companion-directory control rejected before writing. The new directory is reserved with mkdir(exist_ok=False). No separate companion-directory defect is claimed.
